name: Suzuki RG125 Gamma
engine: 124 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke single, power valve
intro: A small two-stroke sport bike for European learners.

B: Suzuki's CCI system pumps oil into the engine, so it does not need premix. Check the oil tank, pump and lines. If the pump was removed, it runs premix.

recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
